description: This Dart file defines an API client service for Flutter applications, including the ApiClient class with methods for HTTP GET, POST, PATCH, and DELETE requests, and the ApiException class for error handling. It uses environment variables for configuration and manages authorization headers.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: Represents an HTTP error response with status and message, used for error handling in API requests.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: Provides helper methods for making HTTP requests (GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE) with automatic JSON encoding/decoding, base URL configuration, and optional authorization token injection.

methods.name: ApiClient
methods.description: Constructor for ApiClient, initializes base URL and optional token supplier.

methods.name: _computeBaseUrl
methods.description: Determines the base URL for API requests from environment variables or falls back to default.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request and returns parsed JSON or null if response is empty.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with optional JSON body and returns parsed JSON.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PATCH request with optional JSON body and returns parsed JSON.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request and returns parsed JSON if present.

methods.name: _buildUri
methods.description: Constructs the complete URI for the request by combining base URL, path, and query parameters.

methods.name: _joinUrl
methods.description: Concatenates base URL and path, ensuring proper slashes.

methods.name: _buildHeaders
methods.description: Creates request headers, including authorization if token is provided, and content type if needed.

methods.name: _handleResponse
methods.description: Processes the HTTP response, decoding JSON or throwing an ApiException for errors.
